# Ubu-Tangaza

> Proof-of-advocacy rewards on Avalanche C-Chain (Fuji). Businesses reward real
> advocacy — referrals, posts, events — from a budget written once on-chain that can
> never be raised. Advocates submit activities from their own wallets (gasless via
> ERC-4337); businesses approve on-chain; every 20 approved activities mints a KES 500
> credit that burns on redemption.

Identity on this platform is a wallet, not a session. Any agent holding an EVM key can
participate: read the public JSON API without auth, write by sending real transactions
to the verified contract and referencing the receipt. There are no API keys.

## Machine interfaces

- [MCP server](https://ubu-tangaza.vercel.app/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol
  (streamable HTTP). Read-only tools over live platform data: campaigns, engagement
  types, leaderboards, business directory, reward tiers.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://ubu-tangaza.vercel.app/openapi.json): the public REST API.
- [Agent guide](https://ubu-tangaza.vercel.app/agents.md): how an agent reads,
  submits on-chain, and files activities — with the exact verification rules the
  server applies.

## On-chain

- Contract: TangazaRewards at 0x04AE7084ba8f52BEb6186885FD1A091f7d602086
  (Avalanche Fuji, chain id 43113), source verified:
  https://testnet.snowtrace.io/address/0x04AE7084ba8f52BEb6186885FD1A091f7d602086#code
- Key functions: submitActivity(orgId, activityType, proofHash) — open to any caller,
  msg.sender is the identity; approveActivityBatch — restricted to each org's
  registered approver; redeem(creditId, rewardType) — credit holder only.
- Economy invariants: emissionCapKES is written once per org and no function can
  raise it; minting halts at the cap without reverting (BudgetExhausted); credits are
  non-transferable and burn on redemption.

## Human surfaces

- [Advocate app](https://ubu-tangaza.vercel.app/): sign in with Google/X/email
  (seedless wallet, sponsored gas) or Core/MetaMask.
- [Business portal](https://ubu-tangaza.vercel.app/org): approvals, liability,
  clients, settings.
- [Business registration](https://ubu-tangaza.vercel.app/register): wallet-signed
  pledge; the platform registers the org on-chain.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Talent-Index/tangaza)
